Times are Asia/Seoul. Newest first.

## 2026-11-11 02:15 · claude-macbook · immersivevfx-nofog

ImmersiveVFX 2.0.0 + NoFog (nofog-fabric-26.3) = world fully fogged, only silhouettes visible. NoFog sets FogData.environmentalStart/End = Float.MAX_VALUE; VfxClient.finishFog lerps `other + (wish - other) * airOpinion`, and with airOpinion = 1.0 (any vanilla biome) MAX + (x - MAX) = 0, so fog runs 0..1 block. Fix used: config/immersivevfx-client.toml fogRenderingMode = "OFF" (VFX adjustFog/finishFog then skip; shaders use vanilla linear_fog_value). Backup: immersivevfx-client.toml.bak-nofog-20261111. Alternative: disable NoFog and restore IMMERSIVE_EXTENDED. Mac GL is 4.1 Metal; unfocused MC window stops rendering (Dynamic FPS), so screencapture -l shows a stale frame.
